policy.statement: OpenOperator adapts bounded product and safety contracts to its Cloudflare-native architecture. This manifest does not claim binary compatibility or direct execution of Twenty modules.

behavioral_tests.contains: persists stable typed step outputs and rejects unsafe workflow lineage
runs automation with typed custom fields and fails closed after metadata drift

integrations.adaptation: Validate trigger/action structure, governed typed custom-field conditions/actions/merge variables, signed field-read authority, stable step identity, reachable prior-step outputs, explicit archival-drift health, and unsafe lineage before persistence or execution.

behavioral_tests.contains: blocks SSRF-shaped webhook destinations and keeps one-time secrets out of reads

integrations.adaptation: Generate high-entropy one-time webhook credentials, return them only at creation, encrypt at rest, and expose only a prefix thereafter.

behavioral_tests.contains: publishes fixed signed workflow events through matching workspace webhook subscriptions
verifies inbound webhook signatures and suppresses replayed events

integrations.adaptation: Server-build a fixed record envelope, exclude endpoint secrets and model-controlled destinations, sign delivery, and suppress replay.

behavioral_tests.contains: renames, merges, edits, and deletes company identity data with one-winner guards

integrations.adaptation: Preview relationship impact before merge, bind approval to a signed versioned review, atomically move relationships, and retain durable redirects.

local_contracts.contains: Only workspace admins can publish shared views

behavioral_tests.contains: versions saved views with private/shared isolation, bounded definitions, atomic audit, and one concurrent winner
filters and displays governed custom fields without permission inference or saved-view drift

integrations.adaptation: Persist a bounded contact-view definition with typed core/custom filters, ordered permission-aware fields, sort, and visibility; execute filters on the server without inference through unreadable fields; conceal private views; sanitize shared-view drift; permission shared publishing; and bind edits and deletion to optimistic revisions with atomic audit evidence.

behavioral_tests.contains: binds member custom-field edits to active governed definitions and exact versioned grants
redacts member custom-field values and definitions consistently across every Contact read surface

integrations.adaptation: Bind each active governed Contact field to explicit member read and update capabilities, redact ungranted values and definitions on every operator read surface, preserve owner/admin full access, require object-update authority plus the exact edit grant, and remove archived fields from the effective policy contract.

behavioral_tests.contains: governs versioned object page layouts with safe drift recovery and exact conflicts

integrations.adaptation: Persist one bounded, ordered custom-field layout per core object; require complete active-field placement on writes; expose a drift-safe effective layout for new and archived fields; and guard admin changes with optimistic revisions and atomic audit evidence.

behavioral_tests.contains: serves a bounded workspace calendar across tasks, follow-ups, and opportunity closes
renders a bounded responsive CRM calendar inside Tasks

integrations.adaptation: Render a six-week month over a server-owned, end-exclusive date range; combine open tasks, contact follow-ups, and open opportunity close dates without open-world object queries; enforce workspace isolation, 93-day admission, 200-per-kind fairness, 500-total truncation, read-only untrusted-record labeling, linked-record navigation, and a compact mobile agenda.
